name: Llinars del Vallès (Spain)
description: Horizontal bicolour of yellow and light blue with a white stripe centred on the division, the yellow charged at the hoist with the black crow of the arms passant towards the hoist.
history: The flag was approved on 19 January 2012 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 6060 of 6 February 2012; it is based on the arms, an oblong flag of 2:3, horizontal bicolour yellow and light blue with a white fess 1/9 of the height centred on the division, and the black crow of the arms passant towards the hoist.

features.role: crow passant towards the hoist, 5/24 of the height
